title: Claude dropped a free plugin that runs entire office for you, chasing invoices, closing your books.
description:
Claude just dropped a free plugin that runs your entire back office. It is called Claude for Small Businesses and it bundles up everything founders are secretly drowning in. Chasing invoices, closing the books, reviewing contracts, sorting leads, prepping for tax season. 30 ready to run jobs, and it plugs straight into QuickBooks, PayPal, and HubSpot.

Setup takes under a minute, and one command does the work of a part time hire for free.

Save this so you can install it later.

#claude #ai #smallbusiness #aitools #productivity #aiforfounders #claudecode
